title: Nautilus RC1 hardening report
content:
Nautilus RC1 hardening report Architecture truth audit summary Capability area Status Evidence Runtime capabilities Implemented + partial src/lib/control-plane/ + scripts/verify-core.js ; remote execution remains policy-gated seam only. Retrieval capabilities (MeshRAG) Partial Local retrieval contracts and degraded states are implemented; graph-hop retrieval is scaffolded-unavailable. Governance capabilities (ThreatMesh/policy) Implemented for fail-closed local gates Policy unavailable path is deny/fail-closed with explicit degraded reason; automated policy promotion remains planned. Replay capabilities Implemented (local verification surfaces) Replay digest/validation paths and tests exist; distributed replay backends are not implemented. Operational intelligence claims Partial Local diagnostics, receipts, and telemetry probes are truthful; no autonomous orchestration claims. Topology/runtime claims Partial OperatorGraph UI and truth-surface fixtures exist; persistent distributed topology graph storage is unavailable. Observability claims Partial Event/degraded/telemetry contracts are implemented with explicit unavailable states and no synthetic healthy fallback. Dependency + dead code audit summary Restored missing review entrypoint scripts referenced by package.json ( review:* commands), resolving broken validation flow. Confirmed review scripts now enforce truth-claim presence, matrix structure, doc index structure, and basic secret-pattern checks. No dependency removal was performed in RC1 hardening because no deterministic unused dependency proof was generated by automated checks in this pass. Release hardening additions Added .env.example for local runtime baseline and controlled flag defaults. Added this RC1 report as release evidence with explicit implemented/partial/unavailable status by capability category. Added deterministic review scripts under scripts/review/ to prevent stale validation references. Degraded-state documentation Nautilus currently documents and surfaces these degraded-state classes: policy engine unavailable (fail-closed deny) retrieval unavailable memory store unavailable trace store unavailable telemetry unavailable/stale/malformed paths Local runtime quick verification npm install --ignore-scripts
npm run verify:core
npm run review:all
For full release verification, run npm run verify:release in a fully provisioned environment. Known limitations Remote worker execution remains transport/policy seam and is not a general distributed scheduler. Dynamo integration, autonomous orchestration, and automatic policy learning remain planned only. Some verification commands require repo-specific toolchain and may fail if local prerequisites are missing
summary: src/lib/control-plane/ + scripts/verify-core.js; remote execution remains policy-gated seam only.
